assumptions.information: identified crew; choose among four T4 pure gun types and a three-class mix
assumptions.collector: one collector added to profit fleet, no guaranteed public recovery
assumptions.capital: dispatched fleet cost reported separately; research/building capital not amortized
assumptions.validation: independent seeds, clustered 95% intervals across pirate crews
assumptions.supply: shared galaxy supply, constant smoothed eligible count every hour, all levels weighted
assumptions.caveat: No live telemetry, visibility, contention, expiry, progression, hangar/bay saturation, intercept wait or return radiation; supply numbers are scenario potentials, not observed server inflow.
